articles.headline: Picard Medical / SynCardia Advances Emperor Total Artificial Heart Program with Successful Next-Generation Preclinical Implant Studies
articles.summary: Picard reported acute animal implant studies of its next-generation Emperor artificial-heart platform. These are preclinical findings; existing approvals for the separate SynCardia device do not establish approval or clinical efficacy of the new Emperor platform.
